title: A Garden for the Veil Revisited
author: Jude Marchetti
blurb: Odile Vane, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
